chapter: New Orleans bands and Buddy Petit tours
title: Houston, Galveston and Lake Charles with pianist Lazy Daddy
summary: The Petit band goes to Houston and Galveston, hires pianist Lazy Daddy, and splits up in Lake Charles; talk of Lazy Daddy's background.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Yeah, he looks short. By the way, you're talking about that tour, then we left and went to Galveston. We left and went to Galveston, Texas. We went to Houston, Texas. First we left here and went to Houston, Texas to play a job. And after we was in Houston for a while, then another guy came out to us and said he got a job for us to go to Galveston, Texas. So we went to Galveston, Texas. I'll never forget, we took a piano player from here with us, but after we got in, after we got out there in Texas, we found out this piano player wasn't what he's supposed to be, so we hired another piano player up there by the name of Lazy Daddy, and he played with us. And we was up there for about three or four months. Then we left there and came to Lake Charles, Louisiana, and played with a bunch there for a while. That's how we, but it split up. stuff
